@graph.name: CCTV Night-Time Vision is White Fog or Washed Out Glare
@graph.description: Root Cause: Infrared reflection bouncing back off dome glass covers, nearby soffit boards, brick corners, or spiderweb buildup. Solution: Replace reflective glass dome with open-lens Turret (Eyeball) camera with separated dual IR/white-light emitters and ColorVu technology.

@graph.name: CCTV Cameras Disconnect or Reboot Every Evening at Dusk
@graph.description: Root Cause: Cheap Copper-Clad Aluminium (CCA) cable drops too much voltage under high electrical load when infrared LEDs activate at sunset. Solution: Replace substandard CCA with 100% solid oxygen-free copper Cat6 cable with IEEE 802.3at PoE+ power budget.

@graph.name: Wi-Fi Drops Completely Inside 500mm Thick Stone Walls or Extensions
@graph.description: Root Cause: High-density Yorkshire gritstone and foil-backed insulation absorb 5GHz and 6GHz wireless signals completely. Solution: Install hardwired solid copper Cat6 backhaul cables to discreet ceiling-mounted Wi-Fi 6/7 access points in every zone.

@graph.name: Starlink Internet Stalls or Drops Satellite Lock in High Winds
@graph.description: Root Cause: Flimsy aluminium poles or cheap swan-neck brackets flex 2–3 degrees in wind gusts, losing phased-array beam alignment. Solution: Mount on heavy-duty non-drill chimney lashing cradles or 18" welded T&K brackets with 2" heavy-gauge mast.

@graph.name: Freeview TV Channels Pixelating, Freezing or Missing Completely
@graph.description: Root Cause: 700MHz 5G or 800MHz 4G mobile phone mast transmission breaking into wideband unshielded TV aerial coax. Solution: Install CAI-benchmarked 5G LTE channel 48 low-pass filter, double-screened Webro WF100 coax, and spectrum analyzer realignment.

@graph.name: DIY 433MHz Wireless Alarms Vulnerable to Cheap RF Jamming
@graph.description: Root Cause: Single-frequency 433MHz wireless devices can be blinded by basic handheld transmitters without triggering an alarm. Solution: Upgrade to Grade 2 Ajax Jeweller 868MHz encrypted rolling-code frequency-hopping system with sub-second jamming detection.

@graph.name: Fear of 75"–85" Heavy OLED TV Pulling Down Plasterboard Drywall
@graph.description: Root Cause: Standard plastic drywall plugs pull straight out of gypsum board under dynamic cantilever forward weight. Solution: Professional structural mounting with CoreFix 120 (into solid block) or SnapToggle (into timber/metal studs) rated to 100kg+.
